ārāmaropā vanaropā, ye janā setukārakā, papañ'ca udapānañ'ca, ye dadanti upassayaṃ.
tam'anugacchanto addasaṃ purāṇaṃ nagaraṃ purāṇaṃ rājadhāniṃ pubbakehi manussehi ajjhāvuṭṭhaṃ ārāmasampannaṃ vanasampannaṃ pokkharaṇīsampannaṃ uddhāpavantaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ.

so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya, atthi pan'āyasmato koci veyyāvaccakaro'ti. cīvar'atthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā, eso kho, āvuso, bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaro'ti.
evaṃ, devā'ti kho so mah'āmatto rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paṭissutvā āyasmato pilindavacchassa pañca ārāmikasatāni pādāsi, pāṭiyekko gāmo nivisi

12489.meaning1: monastery supervisor; supervisor of monastery workers
12489.commentary: (KVt) kammaṃ karonte ārāmike pesan'atthāya dātabbā sammuti ārāmikapesakasammuti. esa nayo sāmaṇerapesakasammutī'ti etthā'pi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena saṅghassa sāṭiyaggāhāpako na hoti… pattaggāhāpako na hoti… ārāmikapesako na hoti… sāmaṇerapesako na hoti. sāmaṇerā apesiyamānā kammaṃ na karonti.

12490.meaning1: state of being a monastery attendant; monastery worker

examples.text: te ārāmikabhūtā vā upāsakabhūtā vā pañcasikkhāpade samādāya vattanti. iti samaṇo gotamo sāvakānaṃ sakkato garukato mānito pūjito, samaṇañ'ca pana gotamaṃ sāvakā sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharantī'ti.

evaṃ, devā'ti kho so mah'āmatto rañño māgadhassa seniyassa bimbisārassa paṭissuṇitvā āyasmato pilindavacchassa pañca ārāmikasatāni pādāsi, pāṭiyekko gāmo nivisi. ārāmikagāmako'ti'pi naṃ āhaṃsu, pilindagāmako'ti'pi naṃ āhaṃsu.

evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu yaññad'eva rattiṃ vā divaṃ vā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, tāva'd'ev'assa tibbaṃ hir'ottappaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti bhikkhūsu bhikkhunīsu upāsakesu upāsikāsu antamaso ārāmikasamaṇ'uddesesu.

12494.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

12495.meaning2: female servant in a monastery, or the wife of an monastery worker

12496.meaning1: vicinity of a monastery; neighbourhood of a monastery; area surrounding a monastery

examples.text: sāsaṅkaṃ nāma ārāme ārām'ūpacāre corānaṃ niviṭṭh'okāso dissati, bhutt'okāso dissati, ṭhit'okāso dissati, nisinn'okāso dissati, nipann'okāso dissati.
pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato nigaṇṭho … muṇḍasāvako… jaṭilako… paribbājako… māgaṇḍiko… tedaṇḍiko… āruddhako… gotamako… devadhammiko yath'ābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. katamehi pañcahi?

12499.grammar: nt, abstr, from na rūpa, neg

examples.text: ye ca rūp'ūpagā sattā, ye ca āruppavāsino, nirodhaṃ appajānantā, āgantāro punabbhavaṃ.

santi, gahapatayo, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, n'atthi sabbaso āruppā'ti. tesaṃ'y'eva kho, gahapatayo, samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ujuvipaccanīkavādā. te evam'āhaṃsu, atthi sabbaso āruppā'ti.
